title: Preview directives authored out of ascending-time order silently arm the wrong preview (last-in-list wins, not latest-in-time)
detail: Selection is the last LIST position matching at_ms <= cap_ms, not the maximum at_ms. The parser accepts any order; a mis-ordered demo silently renders a different prediction than the documented intent, and `harness save` would bless that wrong card as the acceptance-2 golden.
recommended_fix: In preview_event_index, track the event with the maximum at_ms among matches (or reject non-ascending preview directives at parse time, failing loud like an unknown tier).

title: A preview failure during `harness save` skips the capture golden yet save still returns true — the fail is swallowed
detail: The new capture-block failure paths append to `fails` and `continue` (skipping write_golden), but the save branch returns true without ever checking or printing `fails` — a failed preview blesses no golden for that capture while reporting success.
recommended_fix: Check `len(fails) == 0` before the save-branch return (or print fails and return false), so a failed preview directive fails the bless loudly instead of silently skipping the capture.
